name: Achille Mbembe
shortBio: Cameroonian philosopher and political theorist whose concept of necropolitics and critique of the postcolony have redefined contemporary sovereignty, biopolitics, and global racial capitalism.
centralQuestion: Under what practical conditions is the sovereign right to kill exercised, and how does contemporary power reduce vulnerable populations to living-dead status?

keyWorks.title: Necropolitics
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking philosophical investigation of death-worlds, late-modern colonial occupation, and sovereignty as the power to dictate who may live and who must die.

keyWorks.title: On the Postcolony
keyWorks.description: Landmark analysis of power, grotesque theatricality, and conviviality in post-colonial African states.

keyWorks.title: Critique of Black Reason
keyWorks.description: Planetary critique demonstrating how the historical racialization of the Black subject prefigures the universalization of precarious humanity under financialized capitalism.
